subject: Pricing alignment + migration constraints for SummitGrid
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitgrid.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@summitgrid.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing + migration constraints

Hi Avery —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Attached is our RFP excerpt and a short matrix on runtime constraints. A few things that are top of mind for Procurement and Engineering:

- We received a competing offer from CloudRun Partners: $0.0026/token for standard generation, 18% discount first year, plus a $40k migration credit.
- They’re offering a 1-week parallel run support package (engineer-in-residence) during cutover.
- We need SOC 2 evidence and confirmation on VPC/private deployment options (air gapped is not required, just private subnet + KMS).

Can Redwood match the unit pricing and the migration assistance? If you can come close on economics and commit to a short handoff SLA, we can accelerate the POC and legal.

Attaching: SummitGrid_RFP_Q3.pdf and runtime-interop-matrix.csv

Cheers,
Maya Patel
Director, Cloud Platforms
SummitGrid

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitgrid.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + migration constraints

Hi Maya —

Appreciate the details and the attachments. Quick clarifying Qs before I loop in pricing and ops:

1) Is the CloudRun token number (the $0.0026) based on their standard gen model or a quantized variant?
2) Is the $40k migration credit contingent on a 12mo commit?
3) Any mandatory uptime/SLA terms in their term sheet we should see?

I’ll bring Connor (pricing) and Jasmine (solutions) into the thread — we may have a structured match we can offer tied to migration milestones and a limited-time onboarding SLA.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitgrid.io>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Carl Nguyen <carl.nguyen@summitgrid.io>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + migration constraints

Thanks, Avery. Answers below:

1) CloudRun quoted for their standard gen model (no extra quantization).
2) Yes, $40k is tied to a 12-month committed annual subscription.
3) They included a 99.9% prod SLA and a 30-day rollback carveout in case of severe regressions.

Procurement wants a price-match letter and a clear migration runbook. Engineering wants explicit details on KV cache persistence and prefix cache portability during a short cutover.

Happy to hop on a quick call today if that helps.

-Maya

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pricing + migration constraints — SummitGrid asks for match + migration aid

Team — forwarding SummitGrid’s ask. Key asks: match ~ $0.0026/token for std gen, $40k migration credit (tied to 12mo), 1-week engineer-in-residence style support, SOC2 evidence, VPC deployment details.

My initial thoughts: we should avoid an unconditional price match — instead offer a conditional match tied to: 12mo committed term, agreed onboarding milestones (30/60/90), and a short SLA addendum. Also consider a limited migration credit ($30k) + 3 days of EIR + discounted premium support hours.

Can you outline an internal playbook we can present (pricing + packaging options) plus a short runbook for the handoff (engineering asks)? I’ve attached the RFP and the runtime matrix for reference.

Thanks — Avery

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pricing + migration constraints — SummitGrid asks for match + migration aid

Avery / Connor — see proposed options below (keeps legal exposure limited and gives sales levers):

Option A — Conditional Match (recommended):
- Unit price: $0.0026/token for standard generation for first 12 months (true-up at renewal to our list price if usage < threshold)
- Migration assistance: $30,000 credit + 3 days EIR onsite/virtual (engineer in residence) included
- Term: 12 months minimum commit
- SLA: 99.9% with a 14-day rollback carveout for production regressions (rather than 30-day)
- Requirements: Signed migration runbook, test-suite pass on pre-prod, SOC2 evidence shared prior to go-live

Option B — Discounted Runbook (lower upfront cost):
- Unit price: $0.0030/token for 12 months
- Migration assistance: $15,000 credit + 2 days remote EIR
- Term: month-to-month with an onboarding fee credit applied if 12mo commit later

Risks / Commercial notes:
- If we match price without a term, customers churn risk increases. Tie credit to term and success milestones.
- Engineering wants explicit KV cache compatibility notes — I can draft a short "cache portability checklist" referencing runtime-interop-matrix.csv
- Attach: competitor-offer-summary.pdf (internal summary), runtime-interop-matrix.csv

Next steps: Connor — can you run margin impact vs. list pricing and confirm whether $0.0026 is acceptable at the requested commit levels? I’ll draft the runbook and the limited SLA language for legal.

Jasmine Liu
Solutions Architect
Redwood Inference

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@summitgrid.io>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing + migration constraints

Maya —

Thanks for the patience while we pulled options together. Based on our evaluation, here’s a concise proposal we can sign to move things forward quickly: 

- Offer: Conditional price match to $0.0026/token for standard generation for the first 12 months.
- Commercials: $30,000 migration credit applied to onboarding invoice; credit is payable only if SummitGrid executes a 12-month committed subscription within 30 days of proposal acceptance.
- Onboarding: 3 days EIR (remote) included plus a dedicated onboarding runbook with explicit KV cache portability steps; we will run a pre-prod test suite and provide SOC2 artifacts before go-live.
- SLA: 99.9% with a 14-day post-production rollback window for severe regression (requires trigger definition in runbook).
- Legal: We will provide a short price-match letter and a limited amendment to standard T&Cs; redlines accepted only for defined carveouts.

If that sounds acceptable I can send a preliminary term sheet and loop in Legal. Can we aim to have a signed term sheet by EOD next Friday to hit your Q3 onboarding window?

Best regards,
Avery Johnson
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: SummitGrid_RFP_Q3.pdf, runtime-interop-matrix.csv
